description: The capability tree: what services do, as branches, leaves and leaves' children, each with a one-line description and the number of services in it (zeros included). Read it once (follow its guide), choose the most specific node that matches your task, then call search_services with branch set to its id, or up to three ids separated by commas when more than one fits. format "text" returns the same tree as plain text, one line per node: the cheapest to read. Keep it and pass since_revision later to get only what changed. IDs are permanent: an id that moved (listed under moved) still works as a branch filter.

format.description: json (default) or text: one line per node, about half the size of json.

since_revision.description: The revision of a copy you hold: returns only the node changes since then (or unchanged: true) instead of the tree. Service counts are refreshed every hour and are not changes.

name: get_tree
title: Get the capability tree
